result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (MCP tool registration, schemas, error handling, API contract). 1 MEDIUM, 3 LOW, no CRITICAL/HIGH. MEDIUM: a documented idempotent spawn_worker retry is rejected with "request_id already used with different arguments" when SWARMFORGE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes between call and retry, because that config default is injected into the hashed fingerprint (src/coordinator.ts:185-190, src/store.ts:71-74); reproduced end-to-end. LOW: retry echoes the current state, not the documented initial queued state (src/mcp.ts:81); schema violations surface as JSON-RPC -32602, not isError, so the handler ZodError branch is unreachable and unredacted (src/mcp.ts:57, docs/MCP-API.md:25); get_worker_artifact collapses all failures into one message and alone skips redaction and the 128 KiB cap (src/mcp.ts:215). Read-only: no source changes; /workspace/repo clean at baseline 5672ead. Report: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md.
result.details:
Method: disposable clone /tmp/rv at exact target (git rev-parse HEAD verified), official Bun 1.4.2 in /tmp, lockfile untouched. Reviewed src/mcp.ts, src/domain.ts, src/files.ts, src/security.ts, src/coordinator.ts, src/store.ts, src/http.ts, src/cli/client.ts and docs/MCP-API.md. src/mcp.ts and docs/MCP-API.md are unchanged from baseline 5672ead, so all findings are pre-existing at the target, not delta regressions.

F1 MEDIUM (reproduced): coordinator.spawn injects timeout_seconds ?? SWARMFORGE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS before Store.create hashes JSON.stringify(input) into request_fingerprint, so a value the caller never supplied is part of the request identity. A lead that follows docs/MCP-API.md:29 (reuse request_id and arguments) after an operator edits limits.default_timeout_seconds gets isError 'request_id already used with different arguments' for byte-identical arguments, and the key is unrecoverable. tests/lifecycle.test.ts:6-19 and tests/core.test.ts:87-114 only retry with an unchanged config, so the existing guard misfires untested. Fix: hash the caller-supplied Spawn.

F2 LOW (reproduced): retry returns state 'booting' where the first call returned 'queued', contradicting docs/MCP-API.md:7.

F3 LOW (reproduced over 18 cases): the SDK validates inputSchema before the callback, so every invalid-argument call is a JSON-RPC -32602 error, not isError; docs/MCP-API.md:25 is wrong, src/cli/client.ts:31-50 only inspects isError, and the only path validating untrusted input is the one path not passed through redactor.text (no value echo observed in 6 targeted cases, so no leak today).

F4 LOW (reproduced): get_worker_artifact's bare catch returns 'Artifact unavailable or invalid path' for unknown/destroyed workers, traversal, symlink, credential-shaped path and provider timeout, and being registered directly it bypasses register()'s redaction and 128 KiB cap (no live disclosure: files.artifact already blocks credential-shaped paths).

Verified sound: 17 tools match the documented names/defaults/bounds; resources/read rejects offset=-1, offset=abc, offset>2^53, length=0, length=99999999 and duplicate params; nested %2F paths round-trip; wait_for_state_change works over real HTTP (event in ~150 ms, timeout_ms=0 checks once); results survive destroy; SSE ids and cursors share one sequence.

Limitations: full suite and build not run (whole-suite/packaging scopes); real Freestyle/OpenCode providers not exercised. Reviewer probes live only in /tmp/rv/review-probe (10 tests, 0 fail) and are outside the source checkout.

result.followup_reason: Actionable MEDIUM defect: the documented idempotent spawn_worker retry contract is broken whenever the configured default timeout changes, because the config default participates in request_id's fingerprint (src/coordinator.ts:185-190 + src/store.ts:71-74). Fix by fingerprinting the caller-supplied arguments only, and add a regression test that retries with a changed SWARMFORGE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. Also worth fixing the three LOW items (retry state echo vs docs/MCP-API.md:7, -32602 vs isError error contract, and get_worker_artifact's opaque error + missing redaction/size cap).
